simB_helpful:
Thanks for checking. The key point is that the proceeds should **not** be split using the current 72.94% debt / 27.06% equity proportions.

Use the proceeds first to **pay down debt only as far as needed to bring D/E down to 2.60x from the baseline**. Any proceeds left after that should be used for the share repurchase.

On the buyback price, I have no further instruction on whether to apply the 15% tender premium on top of the post-drop price; your default of using the post-drop market price is fine.

On the 1% transaction fee, I also have no further instruction; proceed with your default treatment.

Also make sure the buyback is calculated on the **remaining proceeds after the required debt paydown**, not on the full proceeds.
scripted: Use the proceeds to pay down debt until the debt to equity ratio comes down to 2.60x; the remaining proceeds go to share repurchases.
